reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC) AS spend_rank
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_rank = 1
alternatives:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
channel_max AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, MAX(spend) AS max_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT cs.channel_id, cs.campaign_id, cs.spend
FROM campaign_spend cs
JOIN channel_max cm ON cm.channel_id = cs.channel_id AND cm.max_spend = cs.spend

WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cs.channel_id, cs.campaign_id, cs.spend
FROM campaign_spend cs
WHERE cs.spend = (SELECT MAX(cs2.spend) FROM campaign_spend cs2 WHERE cs2.channel_id = cs.channel_id)

other_way.tradeoff: Joining each channel's highest spend keeps every tied campaign too, and it reads well for first place but not for a top 3.

solver.query:
WITH camp AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC) AS rk
  FROM camp
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1
